scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && PORT=${PORT:-3000} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} pnpm --filter @workspace/airport-delay-dashboard run build
